title: Table Styles Comprehensive Test — All Types
author: Test Suite

sections.title: Simple Style — Default
sections.content:
The simple style is the standard table. Navy header, alternating light-grey zebra stripes.

[TABLE:simple:Simple Table — Default]
| Column A | Column B | Column C |
|----------|----------|----------|
| Data 1 | Data 2 | Data 3 |
| Data 4 | Data 5 | Data 6 |
| Data 7 | Data 8 | Data 9 |
[/TABLE]

sections.title: Bold — First Column
sections.content:
col1-bold bolds the first column.

[TABLE:simple:First Column Bold:col1-bold]
| Region | Sales | Growth |
|--------|-------|--------|
| North | 1000 | +12% |
| South | 800 | +5% |
| East | 1200 | +18% |
[/TABLE]

sections.title: Bold — Multiple Columns
sections.content:
Use colN-bold to bold any column. Stack multiple.

|--------|-------|----------|-------|
| North | 1000 | Enterprise | 2200 |
| South | 800 | SMB | 1700 |
| East | 1200 | Enterprise | 2400 |
[/TABLE]

sections.title: Status Colors — Cell Level (4 Tiers)
sections.content:
Four colour tiers: jade (good), amber/yellow (neutral/in progress), orange (warning), red-orange (error/critical). Only the status cell is coloured — rows keep normal zebra stripes.
